R44BI.head: 11f4d734368d53b4634f2eb1542087d1a8a526e7
R44BI.theorem: Arbitrary shared fresh hubs padded into arbitrary clause subsets and unit-forced to their disabling values preserve maximum deficiency exactly.
R44BI.scope: Shared hubs may be globally nonlocal, but their exactness is only unit-disabling; nontrivial functional constraints remain open.

R44BJ.head: 4d90d6e59e52a3e79e2499940b3fbaea9dfff162
R44BJ.theorem: A shared single-variable proxy y equivalent to x cannot lower maximum deficiency under arbitrary occurrence redirection.
R44BJ.formula: delta*(T_equiv(F))>=delta*(F); if a maximum-deficiency witness contains x, the standard two-clause equivalence gadget gives a transformed witness of deficiency delta*(F)+1.
R44BJ.scope: Functional copy only; multi-input gates remain open.

R44BK.head: 7fa2cfca603166029c6d91d65a7fa98c234d1ac8
R44BK.theorem: If r>=2 input variables are exclusive to a repeated common-disjunction block and that block is replaced by one exact shared OR proxy y, any maximum-deficiency witness touching the block becomes a transformed witness with deficiency increased by r-1.
R44BK.formula: delta*(T(F))>=delta*(F)+(r-1) under the stated exclusive-input/witness condition.
R44BK.scope: Mixed/nonexclusive gate inputs, witnesses avoiding the compressed block, later semantic simplification, and arbitrary multi-input gates remain open.
